title: Always the same water
style: Photorealistic nature documentary, natural light, gentle slow camera movement, rich color, high detail

shots.prompt: Low camera gliding over the open ocean surface at sunrise, small waves glittering with golden light, horizon slightly tilted.
shots.narration_pt: Toda gota de chuva que você já viu foi oceano.
shots.narration_en: Every raindrop you have ever seen was once ocean.

shots.prompt: The camera slows and lowers toward the water; thin wisps of vapor rise from the warm surface, backlit by the low sun.
shots.narration_pt: O sol aquece a superfície, e a água sobe.
shots.narration_en: Sunlight warms the surface, and water rises as vapor.

shots.prompt: Time-lapse of white cumulus clouds forming and swelling over the sea under a deep blue sky.
shots.narration_pt: Lá no alto, o ar esfria e vira nuvem.
shots.narration_en: Higher up, the air cools and the vapor becomes cloud.

shots.prompt: The clouds darken and thicken into a storm front rolling over forested mountains, light fading.
shots.narration_pt: As nuvens crescem, pesadas e escuras, sobre as montanhas.
shots.narration_en: The clouds grow heavy and dark over the mountains.

shots.prompt: Heavy rain falling on a dense pine forest, slow push-in between the trunks, mist between the trees.
shots.narration_pt: Então a gravidade vence, e a água volta a cair.
shots.narration_en: Then gravity wins, and the water falls back down.

shots.prompt: Macro shot: a raindrop hits a broad green leaf and splashes, smaller droplets roll off the edge in slow motion.
shots.audio: single crisp droplet impact, soft rain
shots.narration_pt: Cada gota encontra um caminho: folha, pedra, chão.
shots.narration_en: Each drop finds a path: leaf, stone, soil.

shots.prompt: A small clear mountain stream running over mossy rocks, camera follows the water downstream at ground level.
shots.narration_pt: Os filetes se juntam e viram riacho.
shots.narration_en: Trickles join and become a stream.

shots.prompt: A tall waterfall plunging into a misty canyon, slow tilt down following the falling water.
shots.narration_pt: O riacho ganha força e despenca pelo vale.
shots.narration_en: The stream gathers force and plunges into the valley.

shots.prompt: Aerial drone shot of a wide river winding through a green valley in late afternoon light.
shots.narration_pt: Lá embaixo, já é um rio largo e paciente.
shots.narration_en: Down below, it is now a wide and patient river.

shots.prompt: The drone continues as the river passes a small town at dusk, warm window lights reflecting on the water.
shots.narration_pt: Ele atravessa cidades, gira turbinas, enche copos.
shots.narration_en: It runs through towns, turns turbines, fills glasses.

shots.prompt: Aerial view of a river delta meeting the sea, brown river water swirling into deep blue ocean water.
shots.narration_pt: E, no fim, encontra o mar de onde saiu.
shots.narration_en: And in the end, it meets its sea.

shots.prompt: The camera rises from the waves toward a sunset sky where the first thin clouds begin to form.
shots.narration_pt: Para começar tudo de novo. Sempre a mesma água.
shots.narration_en: Only to begin again. Always the same water.
